works.body:
Hi i am in love with your art and would like to commission for my OC Nyro.

Nyro is an shy and elegant moon bunny. 
i love this idea and would like to commission something similar. https://skeb.jp/@shiramigame/works/4
for elements i think it would suit Nyro to be either 'cryo' or 'hydro' catalyst.
you can give nyro a new outfit aswell. but dont please dont change his ears or the flower on his head
i leave the overall composition to you

Thank you
Have fun drawing ! ^^

Hello! I love the work that you did for me last time. Can I request another picture of Silo? I will leave the pose and composition up to you, but I would like to see cherry blossoms like last time. Maybe Silo can be sleeping near a tree?

I want the resolution to be 16:9, if possible, for use on Twitch. Also, if the character can be separated from the background, that would be great, but it's not that necessary.

https://drive.google.com/drive/u/1/folders/1XLEGMPSRXv3vZGVTo2IJGeetJA1YhTZy

Hello ! I really like your art and I would like to request of you a drawing of my FFXIV character, Finaen.

He's an adventurer in a fantasy setting, and a skilled magician traveling the world to help those in need with both his skills in healing magic and his fighting abilities. He's usually very calm and gentle, but can become passionate in the midst of battle. He can sometimes get melancholic and somber when he thinks about the crimes he has committed in the past and for which he tries to atone.

He mostly uses his magic to fight but can also fight with a sword, using his magic foci (the four blue weapons) as a mean to fly in the air in his back, like a pair of wings.

I would like the clothes to be the same as in the references. Feel free to include or not his weapons. Please include his tattoo and diadem.
I leave the composition to you.

References : 
https://imgur.com/a/2wcDCJU

Thank you for your consideration !

I would like to request a waist-up drawing of my brother's OC! His favorite color is purple so if the main tone of the painting has similar lighting to this piece (https://skeb.jp/@opp_grr/works/4) that would be great! I'd like his character to be surrounded by purple orchids.

Hello! I'd love to request art of my vtuber Cerise Daemon. :)
I'd like it to be a vertical image, beucase I'd like to use it on my schedule image and my twitter avatar.

The appearance and clothes are as depicted on the reference sheet I will attach.
She is very curious of the human world, happy and smug. Her eyes are teal blue, they only turn pink when she turns seductive.

The background should be related to cherryblossom trees and spring.
She would be surprised to see them in bloom and the blossom flowers. Maybe even have some cherry blossoms fall on her head? I'll leave those details to your artistic freedom!

Thank you so much, take care and have a nice day!

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1U1beKRTtt97WnRufYjB91o6esPp7vM80/view?usp=sharing

Hello! Since skeb's on campaign I think it is better to request here. Thanks for your last illustration (PID98627146) and it is one of my favourite. I hope you can consider my request again!

Can you draw my original character? (Basic settings in the previous request.) Please use the outfit in the folder "デザイン2": this is his outfit as adventurer in the past. Imagine that he has some "personal matters" to deal with unrelated to the academy. Since he doesn't need to hold his identity as a professor for that, I guess he is a bit wilder and more intimidating there.

Since he is so good at magic there is no restriction on how he casts magic at all. E.g. he doesn't always need a wand (like "1137272-1.output.jpg" in the ref) or any body posture (so that he can just sit there and magic appears). He can also summon wind sword as well. These are just some of the possibilities, but you can decide how would he looks like. I will leave the everything to you and please draw as you want, thanks!!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NQ-dg1Q8t5h1huexZKbtNQ-wvJXo4NuF?usp=sharing

Hiii! I would love to request my original character in your style! :,)

I would like my OC Belle in the same mask and horn as Nastume Takashi is wearing in these references: https://imgur.com/a/4NLhGt2 . I want one eye to be visible and a bit of her mouth. She has a smug smile and her finger in front of her mouth in a 'Don't say anything about me' / 'sshhhhh' way. She is undercover so she would like to not be discovered. 

The background could be a traditional Japanese house with the door open and arms trying to suck her into the house. This is only a suggestion so it's up to you how you want to draw the background! :,))

Thank you and have a great day!

Hello! It's nice to meet you. I saw your artwork on twitter and it was really amazing!

I was hoping you can draw my character as a [原神] [Genshin Impact] character! The pose and costume is up to you! If possible, you can come up with her weapon, and element! I would love to see what you come up with! 

If this request is not okay, please reject and I will send a different request! Thank you so much!

Hello, I really love your artwork. Your artwork is very unique and cool. If possible, I would love to request a drawing of my original character “Akari”. She has light-purple hair, purple eyes, wears a black-hair ribbon, and is in her early 20s. She is a mercenary. Her personality is stoic and mysterious, but is quite dark and sadistic. 
 
Her composition can be up to you. Please feel free to draw.
 
Thank you for your consideration.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Mq1FX2m1yEPkt1RXlvxRc-8S_0yuPNj4?usp=sharing

Hello, I saw the art you did for Shinobu and your art is absolutely beautiful! You are so talented. I was wondering if you could draw my Vtuber character (please include the horns and earrings in the design as well as the claws) floating upside down above a garden. Please make the flowers all gold roses instead of blue. I would like the character to be tied with golden vines with thorns instead of strings. Instead of the planet in the background from the reference, could you make it a blue moon? If possible can you make the art 16:9 (size) 1920*1080 and please separate as many layers as you can? I would use it as a ending soon screen for my Twitch channel or in YouTube Thumbnails. My character is very ethereal and pensive. If it's okay may I have the PSD file too? It's okay if not! 

Reference pose: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1LtcVykBZrgBLR9jbPjOYDC8qXh006o3A/view?usp=drivesdk 

Garden reference: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Lz2ERSnLf8iNJfWdlP_Bm3Ugb-hb2TEm/view?usp=drivesdk

Hello there! 

Your illustrations are beautiful and show off how cool some characters could be, so I would love to put a request in! 

I would love to request my OC Sven from you! https://imgur.com/a/NS3u08K

His outfit would be different from his references, instead it would be a simple black shirt and pants but very roughed up and damaged. He would look very injured but determined!

His left arm is dismembered from the elbow down, the blue one you see is a magical one that extends from that. For this illustration, he wouldn't have it and his arm would be cut off from the elbow down. 

The pose would be similar to this, except his left arm would be at his side. In his hand would be a fancy black dagger https://imgur.com/a/T3z3Er0

Just like your Pixiv illustrations, I would love for him to have a powerful aura around him of that black smoke and blue energy! The color scheme and composition would look like this https://imgur.com/a/kYlm32i

The rest is up to you, thank you!

https://imgur.com/a/NS3u08K
